title: Inputs to operations
log: 2026-10-29T12:22:33Z write: the API refused it in the chapter request, so it is written on its own next

match.reason: No point in the bank covers transformed and transforming resources; the closest, the systems approach, only says a business turns inputs into outputs and is a broader management idea.

draft.title: Inputs to operations
card: Inputs are the resources a business puts into its operations process. They fall into two groups, based on what happens to them.
the inputs that are changed in the process, such as materials, information and customers.
the inputs that do the changing, such as staff, equipment and buildings. They are used, but they do not become the output.
To classify an input, ask one question: is it being changed, or is it doing the changing? The same type of resource can be either, depending on the business.
draft.remember: Transformed inputs are changed. Transforming inputs do the changing.

a.q: Which input is a transforming resource for a bakery in Orange?
opts: The ovens used to bake the bread
The flour used to make the dough
The yeast mixed into the dough
The orders recorded by the customers
a.why: The ovens do the changing and are not turned into bread. Flour is the tempting option, but it is a material that is changed into the loaf, so it is a transformed resource.
a.clue: Which input is used but does not become the bread?

b.q: Priya runs a hair salon in Bendigo. Which input is a transformed resource in her salon?
opts: The customers whose hair is cut and styled
The hairdressers who cut and style the hair
The scissors and dryers used on each client
The salon building rented on the main street
b.why: The customers are the ones changed by the process, as their hair is cut and styled. The hairdressers are tempting because they do the work, but staff do the changing, so they are a transforming resource.
b.clue: Ask who or what is being changed, not who is doing the work.

a.best: The ovens used to bake the bread

b.best: The customers whose hair is cut and styled
